headline: We open doors
standfirst: We are a volunteer group, starting in Barcelona, and we think AI should be for everyone. Panels, workshops, events and more are in the works.

doorways.title: Come along
doorways.body: Nothing has a date yet. Leave your email and you will be the first to know when something does.

doorways.title: Help make it happen
doorways.body: We are volunteers, and there is plenty to do. If you can teach, organise, translate, design or write, we would like to hear from you.

doorways.title: Lend us a space
doorways.body: A library, a community hall, an office after hours, the back room of a café. If you have a space in or near Barcelona, tell us about it.

promises.title: Not a company.
promises.body: We are volunteers, and we have nothing to sell you.

promises.title: Not an AI lab.
promises.body: We do not build AI and we do not train models.

promises.title: Not neutral about harm.
promises.body: When a tool is wrong, biased or unsafe, we say so plainly.

promises.title: Not cheerleaders.
promises.body: We are not here to make you like AI. We would rather be useful.

whyQuote: Make AI an open door, not a locked lab.
whyBody: Most of what is said about AI is written for people who already work in tech. If the tools only help them, the people already left out fall further behind. We want everyone to feel able to try it, so the choice of whether to use it, and what for, is theirs.
closing: The future belongs to all of us.
